label: H.R. 2255
title: Federal Law Enforcement Officer Service Weapon Purchase Act of 2025
short_title: Federal Law Enforcement Officer Service Weapon Purchase Act of 2025

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.

summary: Federal Law Enforcement Officer Service Weapon Purchase Act This bill directs the General Services Administration to establish a program under which a federal law enforcement officer may purchase a retired firearm from the agency that issued the firearm to the officer.
summary_short: Federal Law Enforcement Officer Service Weapon Purchase Act This bill directs the General Services Administration to establish a program under which a federal law enforcement officer may purchase a retired firearm from the agency that issued the firearm to the officer.
